document: SP16:1980 Design Aids for Reinforced Concrete to IS456:1978

geometry_basis.reinforcement_distribution: equal steel on two opposing faces
geometry_basis.assumed_bars: four equal 200 mm2 bar positions, 2 on each opposite face

scan_calibration.notes: Estimates based on original chart image; red minor-grid and thick solid curve overlap; uncertain locations

digitization_method: Manual visual reading of the original scan at y=0.25 and y=0.44, cross-checked against independent previously reported hand calculations; coarse ordinate only, not curve vectorization
sampling_uncertainty_note: Readings intentionally rounded to 0.001-0.002 normalized moment; 0.010 absolute normalized moment acceptance band bounds crowding, curve identification and scan uncertainty. Do not interpret as exact full-curve verification.
